title: error
description: Normalized provider failure: a closed class, a stable code, whether a retry can help, and a message that is safe to show. The raw provider text never appears in a field; diagnostic_ref points to an artifact that holds it. The class 'unknown' means the failure could not be classified; it is not the orchestration stage status 'unknown_outcome' (the request may have been executed), which needs reconciliation before any retry. Retry decisions belong to the run policy, not to this record.

code.description: Stable upper-case code of the failure within its class.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same request can succeed; a default of the class that a rule may override.

safe_message.description: Short message without provider text, safe to show and log.

retry_after_s.description: Seconds to wait before a retry, when the provider said so.

provider.description: Provider id that produced the failure.

request_id.description: Identifier of the request at the provider or the CLI, for diagnostics.

diagnostic_ref.description: Reference to an artifact that holds the raw provider output; the text itself is never copied here.

error-class.description: Failure class: authentication (credentials rejected), authorization (not allowed), quota (usage limit reached), rate_limit (too many requests), invalid_request (the request is wrong), model_unavailable (the model cannot serve), content_policy (refused by policy), transport (connection or protocol failure), provider_internal (provider-side fault), timeout (no answer in time), context_limit (the context is exhausted: a retry or another provider does not help, the plan has to change), unknown (not classified).

scope.description: What the failure applies to: one request, the session, the account, or the whole provider.
